column1:
Showers or thundershowers may occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending
from Kaluthara to Batticaloa via Galle, Hambantota and Pottuvil. Showers or thundershowers may
occur at a few places in the other sea areas around the island during the evening or night.
Winds will be variable in direction. Wind speed will be (20-30) kmph.

The sea areas around the island will be slight.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.
